terms.gloss: the property a bride brings to her husband
evidence: Plaut. Aul. 238b: At nihil est dōtis quod dem.
terms.comment: A wife with a dowry is dōtāta, one without is indōtāta. Since the Augustan age also a gift of nature, an endowment.

phrases.latin: atque eam dēspondē mī. — At nihil est dōtis quod dem. — Nē duās.
phrases.english: and promise her to me. — But I have no dowry to give. — Then give none.

phrases.latin: convēnisse ut nē quid dōtis mea ad tē afferret fīlia
phrases.english: that we agreed my daughter should bring you no dowry at all

sources: Lewis & Short: dos
